title: TEENAGER LENNART KARL JOINS YAMAL, MBAPPE AND RAUL ON A VERY SHORT LIST
description:
Five Champions League goals before 19. Only three players had done it first.

Lennart Karl chipped Jan Oblak in the 54th minute. Cheeky, and no apology offered. That made him the fourth player on the list, after Lamine Yamal, Kylian Mbappe and Raul.

Konrad Laimer added a second in the 74th minute, from a lofted Harry Kane pass.

Assistant Aaron Danks was in charge, and Bayern still won 2-0. Atletico sat 23rd of 36, and they have never won the Champions League. Bayern made the wait longer.

Future superstar or too early to say? Tell us where you stand on Karl.
